module: Auxiliary controller that gives the driver control of the selectable 4WD: 4WD shaft (connected/disconnected), range box (high/low) and differentials. It acts either via `driveModes` controllers (if their names are listed in the jbeam), or directly via the `powertrain` API for old vehicles. It writes `electrics.values.mode4WD` and `modeRangeBox` (1 or 0) and adds entries to the radial menu.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `shaftName` (transfer shaft, powertrain device whose `mode` is "connected" or "disconnected"), `rangeBoxName` (range box, mode "low" or "high"). Read by initLastStage: `driveModesRangeNames`, `driveModesTransfercaseNames`, `driveModesDifferentialNames` (tables of driveModes controller names).
`M.relevantDevice = "transfercase"`: used to sort this controller relative to the powertrain device of the same name.
The input action calls toggleDiffs/toggle4WD/toggleRange if a 4wd controller exists; otherwise it calls the powertrain API directly (compatibility code cited in the file).
The radial menu is built only once (hasBuiltPie flag); it captures the `shaft`/`rangeBox` object from the first init.
There is no `reset` function: controller.reset therefore calls init again on every reset.

relevantDevice.desc: "transfercase": name of the powertrain device used for the call order.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: writes electrics.values.modeRangeBox (1 if low range) and mode4WD (1 if shaft connected).

toggleDiffs.desc: Switches to the next mode of each differential driveModes controller; otherwise calls powertrain.toggleDefaultDiffs().

toggleRange.desc: Switches to the next mode of the range driveModes controllers; otherwise toggles the range box mode via powertrain.toggleDeviceMode.

setRangeMode.desc: Forces the range box mode (powertrain.setDeviceMode). No effect if there is no range box.

toggle4WD.desc: Switches to the next mode of the transfer driveModes controllers; otherwise toggles the 4WD shaft, unless it is physically disconnected (`isPhysicallyDisconnected`).

set4WDMode.desc: Forces the 4WD shaft mode, unless it is physically disconnected.

deserialize.desc: Restores the 4WD and range modes from the serialize data.

init.desc: Finds the powertrain devices (`shaftName`, `rangeBoxName`), initializes the electrics values and adds the radial menu entries (only once).

initLastStage.desc: Finds the driveModes controllers named in `driveModesRangeNames`, `driveModesTransfercaseNames` and `driveModesDifferentialNames` (those that exist).
